steps.label: eig vs. eigvalsh
steps.sub: eigvalsh is the stable, real-guaranteed choice for Hermitian matrices

code:
X = np.array([[0, 1], [1, 0]])

vals, vecs = np.linalg.eig(X)
print(vals)
# [ 1. -1.]
print(vecs)
# [[ 0.7071 -0.7071]
#  [ 0.7071  0.7071]]
caption: Matches the by-hand trace/determinant result: eigenvalues +1 and -1, columns are the eigenvectors.
Every Pauli matrix and Hamiltonian in this course is Hermitian — eigvalsh is the faster, more stable choice.
